description: Defines a Java entity class 'Group' representing user groups within the application, with database persistence annotations and associated properties/methods.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: Represents a user group with properties like id, name, type, permissions, and audit information, mapped to database table SM_GROUP.

methods.name: getGroupName
methods.description: Returns the name of the group.

methods.name: setGroupName
methods.description: Sets the name of the group.

methods.name: getGroupType
methods.description: Returns the type of the group.

methods.name: setGroupType
methods.description: Sets the type of the group.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the set of permissions associated with the group.

methods.name: setPermissions
methods.description: Sets the permissions associated with the group.
